title: Tournesol: A quest for a large, secure and trustworthy database of reliable human judgments

bias_targets.methodology: Collecting personal and demographic data from platform contributors to identify and eventually correct participation imbalances (such as the overrepresentation of young, male, tech-savvy individuals) by re-weighting voting rights.
Eliciting continuous-scale, pairwise human judgments to evaluate and score YouTube videos on how well they celebrate diversity and appeal to minority groups.
